Your Business Deserves the Very Best Protection. You Deserve Exceptional Support.

Get customized business security and fire protection solutions, backed by comprehensive service, state-of-the-art alarm monitoring and 24/7 support. Join thousands of leading businesses who rely on DGA for their peace of mind.

Get Free Consultation Learn More

Smarter Business Security

We have cultivated strong working relationships with numerous residential and commercial security and surveillance companies to ensure the protection of your greatest asset. Inquire here for the options we can provide to you.

Intrusion Alarms

Your business is like no other. Get a customized intrusion system that is effective, unobtrusive and easy to use.

Video Survellience

You can’t be everywhere at once but your OneVIEW system can. Monitor your business from anywhere.

Access Control

Control access to doors, elevator floors or any entry point. Choose from mobile, card, fob or tag credential options.

Alarm Monitoring

Rest easy knowing your systems are backed by our award-winning, UL compliant monitoring centers.
